payload_objects_full_snippets.name: payload
payload_objects_full_snippets.snippet:
{
    action: 'emailtotaskassignment',
    operation: 'createTaskFromEmail',
    mode: 'single',
    source: 'DGO_FAST_Track_WEB_OPS',
    userEmail: AppState.currentUser.email,
    method: 'POST',
    device: { id: 'standalone-html', platform: navigator.platform, ua: navigator.userAgent },
    payload: {
      email: {
        id: em?.id || '',
        subject: em?.subject || title,
        receivedDateTime: em?.receivedDateTime || new Date().toISOString(),
        // P2-4: object form per schema (was bare string)
        fromAddress: fromAddrObj,
        webLink: em?.webLink || '',
        conversationId: em?.conversationId || '',
        internetMessageId: em?.internetMessageId || '',
        bodyPreview: em?.bodyPreview || '',
        bodyContent: em?.bodyContent || em?.body?.content || ''
      },
      task: {
        StartDate: today,
        // P2-4: ActivityID is the email message ID for email-sourced tasks
        ActivityID: em?.id || '',
        Title: title,
        Description: em?.bodyPreview || title,
        Status: 'New',
        Category: category,
        CategoryCode: catCode,
        SubCategory: subcategory,
        SubCategoryCode: subCatCode,
        // P2-4: Categorization composite mirrors the bulk-assignment pattern
        Categorization: category && subcategory ? `${category}-${subcategory}` : (category || ''),
        PrimaryDSU: primaryDSU,
        AssignedTo: assignee,
        AssignedToTitle: assignedToTitle,
        AssignedDSU: primaryDSU,
        // P2-4: Support fields populated from cascading category lookup
        supportingAssignedTo: coassignee,
        SupportAssignedTo: coassignee,
        SupportAssignedToTitle: supportAssignedToTitle,
        SupportDSU: supportDSU,
        SupportDSUKey: supportDSU,
        Priority: priority,
        Timeline: timeline,
        // P2-4: Use tomorrow as default acknowledgement/task due (was today,
        // which is unworkable in practice). Server may override.
        AckDue: tomorrow,
        TaskDue: tomorrow,
        AcknowledgementDueBy: tomorrow,
        // Schema explicitly lists this typo'd field name (AcknolwedgementDueBy)
        // — sending both for forward/backward compatibility.
        AcknolwedgementDueBy: tomorrow,
        TaskDueDate: tomorrow,
        CopyTo: ccList,
        ActionRequired: actionReq,
        Comments: comments,
        CreatedBy: AppState.currentUser.email,
        AttachmentLink: em?.webLink || '',
        // P2-4: Pre-reference ID for traceability
        PreReferenceID: refIdStub
      },
      selection: { single: { ID: em?.id || '', RefIDD: '', Title: em?.subject || '' }, items: [] },
      assignment: { type: 'emailtask' }
    }
  }
